items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And he used to use Steve Anger, he used to use Steve Anger all the time.

ctx.x: percentage. Who did Son Wilson have in his band?
He had, he had me, him, and this guy, Noonie, on piano. Let's see that was, uh, uh, she was. And he used to use Steve Anger, he used to use Steve Anger all the time.
